technical-summary: BRVP06 item 5, bc-serve part: bc-serve inside a build (<build>/radiance_home/bin) reads the build's recorded toolchain.rocm_root and refuses to run when the metadata records none, the recorded SDK is not installed, ROCM_PATH or HIP_PATH resolve elsewhere, or an LD_LIBRARY_PATH directory carries ROCm runtime libraries from another install. Same rule as the launcher's lib/sdk-check.sh; nothing is overridden silently. An executable outside a build (component test builds) has no recorded SDK and is not checked.
user-summary-candidate: bc-serve refuses to run against a different ROCm SDK than the one its build recorded.
